name: Book Employee with Spouse — Spouse Under 18
goal: User attempts to enter a spouse DOB making spouse under 18; bot rejects and user enters a valid DOB.
constraints: First DOB input makes spouse 17; second input is valid (spouse 25).

phases.description: User selects 'Employee with Spouse' and provides spouse name.
User enters spouse DOB making spouse under 18.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot replies with 'Only spouses aged 18 or above are eligible. Please enter a valid date of birth.'
Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
